title: Ten small programs
description: Solve ten short problems (string reversal, prime sieve, matrix multiply, file word count...) with tests for each.
rubric: Each has at least two tests including an edge case
Code is readable with clear names

title: Command-line expense tracker
description: Build a CLI tool that adds, lists and summarises expenses stored in a CSV file, with unit tests.

title: Implement core structures
description: Implement a dynamic array, a linked list, a stack, a queue and a binary heap from scratch with tests.

title: Hash map from scratch
description: Implement a hash map with chaining and resizing; measure load factor against lookup time.
rubric: Resizes at a stated load factor

title: 30 problem DSA ladder
description: Solve 30 graded problems on arrays, two pointers, binary search, recursion, DP and graphs; record time taken per problem.

title: Timed DSA mock test (60 min)
description: A timed set of algorithm questions from the question bank, taken in the Progress page.

title: Proof workbook
description: Write ten proofs: induction, contradiction, pigeonhole and counting arguments.
rubric: Each proof states what is assumed and what is shown

title: Linear algebra in code
description: Implement Gaussian elimination and verify rank-nullity on random matrices; compare with NumPy.

title: Eigenvectors and PCA by hand
description: Compute eigenvectors of a 3x3 covariance matrix by hand, then reproduce with code and interpret.

title: Simulate and infer
description: Simulate coin, dice and Binomial experiments; build confidence intervals and check their coverage empirically.

title: Timed statistics problem set (45 min)
description: Timed problem set on probability, distributions and inference.

title: SQL practice set
description: Write 25 SQL queries (joins, GROUP BY, subqueries, window functions) on a sample schema.

title: Design a course-registration database
description: Design an ER model and normalised schema for course registration with prerequisites; load sample data and write reports.

title: Process and thread lab
description: Write programs using fork/exec, pipes and threads with a mutex-protected counter; demonstrate a race condition and fix it.

title: Scheduler simulator
description: Simulate FCFS, SJF and round-robin scheduling and compare average waiting times.

title: Socket chat
description: Build a TCP client-server chat with multiple clients; capture and annotate the traffic in Wireshark.
rubric: Annotated packet capture of the handshake

title: Cache simulator
description: Simulate a direct-mapped and a 2-way cache on a memory trace and report hit rates.

title: Automata construction set
description: Construct DFAs, NFAs and CFGs for ten given languages; prove one language non-regular.

title: Expression language interpreter
description: Write a lexer, recursive-descent parser and evaluator for an arithmetic language with variables.

title: Team-style project with CI
description: Take a small app through requirements, design doc, tests and a CI pipeline using git branches and pull requests.
rubric: CI runs tests on every push

title: Full-stack app
description: Build a small full-stack web app (e.g. a study-group finder) with authentication, a database and input validation.
rubric: Deployed or runnable with one command

title: End-to-end ML project
description: Pick an open data set, build a baseline and two models, evaluate with cross-validation and write up findings.

title: Implement linear and logistic regression
description: Implement gradient descent for linear and logistic regression from scratch and compare with scikit-learn.

title: End-to-end analytics case study
description: Clean, explore and visualise a public data set (e.g. data.gov.in), answer three business questions with SQL and Python, and present findings.

title: Analyse an A/B test
description: Given A/B test results, compute the effect, a confidence interval and recommend a decision.

title: Search agents
description: Implement BFS, uniform-cost and A* on a grid world and compare nodes expanded.

title: Security review of a web app
description: Review a deliberately vulnerable app for OWASP Top-10 issues and write a remediation report.

title: Containerise and deploy
description: Containerise a small service with Docker, add a health check and run it with docker compose.

title: Sensor dashboard prototype
description: Read a sensor (or simulated sensor), publish over MQTT and show live values on a dashboard.

title: Three-pass paper reading
description: Read three recent papers in your area using the three-pass method and write a one-page critique of each.
rubric: Each identifies contribution, method and a weakness

title: Mini research replication
description: Replicate one result from a published paper, report differences and possible reasons.

title: Essay writing practice
description: Write a 1000-word essay on a social or technical issue every fortnight; revise once using a checklist (thesis, structure, evidence, clarity).
rubric: Clear thesis in the first paragraph
Each paragraph supports the thesis with evidence

title: Statement of purpose draft
description: Write and revise a statement of purpose (two drafts) using feedback from a senior or faculty member.

title: Mock interview
description: A 30-minute mock interview (technical or HR) with a peer, senior or the placement cell, scored on a shared rubric.
rubric: Score of 60% or higher on the rubric

title: Five-minute technical talk
description: Prepare and record a five-minute talk explaining one project to a non-specialist audience.

title: Union Budget analysis
description: Summarise the latest Union Budget's fiscal deficit, major allocations and one policy trade-off in 800 words.
rubric: Key figures cited from the official document

title: Weekly answer writing
description: Write two 250-word answers per week on polity and governance questions and self-review against a model answer.

title: Policy brief
description: Write a two-page policy brief on a local issue (e.g. urban flooding in Bhubaneswar) with options and a recommendation.

title: UPSC prelims-style mock (60 min)
description: Timed multiple-choice mock on polity, economy and environment from the question bank.

title: Ten customer interviews
description: Run ten problem-discovery interviews and summarise patterns in a one-page memo.

title: Build and test an MVP
description: Build a minimum viable product for the validated problem and measure one-week retention with at least 20 users.

title: Pitch deck and unit economics
description: Write a ten-slide pitch with market size, CAC and LTV estimates; present to the incubation cell.
rubric: CAC and LTV estimated with assumptions

title: Local EIA review
description: Read a published environmental impact assessment summary for a project in Odisha and critique its mitigation plan.
